entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Hello, you've reached VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I can certainly help with that. Could I get your name and order number to pull up your account?

Thank you, Jane. I see your order for the VeloPro Carbon cycling shoes, delivered five days ago. To make sure I understand correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or a matter of preference?
They don't fit. They gave me horrible blisters after one ride.

I'm very sorry to hear that. Getting blisters is definitely not the experience we want for our customers, and I understand why you'd want to return them. Since you're well within the 90-day return period for our shoes, I can process a full refund for you.
So I get my money back? Good.

Yes, absolutely. I am emailing you a prepaid return label right now. Please package the cycling shoes in their original box. And just a reminder, please be sure to remove any cleats you may have installed before you send them back.

The email is on its way. Once our warehouse receives the return, your refund will be processed back to your original payment method within 3 to 5 business days. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and I hope we can find a better-fitting option for you in the future. Have a good day.
